declaredGaps: the committed OO interaction census proves the Speech modal exists (plugins/Speech -> modal, controls:0 — the OO rig captured the modal mask, not fields); the OO field contract (Voice / Speed / Pitch) is pinned from the batch PROBES dict and flips deliberately with this probe

OO reads through its SpeechWorker panel; WO drives the Web Speech API (speechSynthesis) — the offline probe STUBS speechSynthesis (headless Chromium has no voices/audio) and gates the queued-utterance contract (text/rate/pitch/lang); actual audio playback is out of probe scope
the voice select is populated from speechSynthesis.getVoices() — the stub ships none, so Default is the only option here; with real voices the select lists them (measured wiring in openSpeechDialog)

contract.behavior: Read aloud collects the selection (or the caret paragraph), opens the dialog; OK queues a SpeechSynthesisUtterance with the collected text, the configured rate/pitch (clamped 0.5..2) and the editor lang (default en-US), then closes; nothing to read -> loud status error and the dialog never opens; Cancel closes and queues nothing
